pr_policy: Each task is a proposed reviewable integration bundle, not an existing PR. Reconcile current local HEAD and overlapping #507/#508 before any later branch/PR operation.
writer_policy: Current AGENTS.md: existing checkout and one integrating writer; preserve dirty files. Parallel agents provide separate analyses and patches.

tasks.title: Structured Gaussian core integration
actions: Integrate in the current common/GLS owner; preserve existing public callsites with explicit adapter.
Bind D,U,F,N,units,rank tolerance and observation order to a compression identity.
Reuse G,s,q and logdet only while C,F,N remain fixed; retain influences for new robust error support.
Keep free-nuisance profile and proper Gaussian marginal branches distinct.
acceptance: Dense precision/whitening/logdet/GLS oracle agrees at declared tolerances.
Dependent and fully aliased nuisance and estimable-only contrasts behave as baseline.
Large-n path forms no n-by-n arrays; memory measured for actual integration.
Sampling covariance uses M C M^T, not an arbitrary weighted Hessian inverse.

program_roles.Sage/Singular: Not required for this matrix integration
program_roles.Lean: Reuse linear algebra results; specialize only newly introduced wrapper assumptions

actions: Keep SelectedLatentBlock/build_cf4_law; bind actual grouped mu,z, errors, group IDs, frames, calibration and selection.

Factor small groups conditionally on shared calibration and velocity fields, preserving selection normalizers and count conditioning.
Separate global, method and angular calibration templates; no independent per-row inflation for a shared zero point.
acceptance: Small selected-block integral normalized against an independent quadrature/reference.
No-selection and narrow-noise limits agree with the existing/reference law.
Bulk/expansion-dipole injection is recovered with uncertainty and radial degeneracy reported.
Quadrature estimated error distinguished from formal certificate; epsrel contract made operative or explicit.
Actual data hash/schema/units/group dedup and selection model provenance recorded.

program_roles.Lean: Specialize accepted endpoint/remainder theorems to provider inputs

tasks.title: CMB map response and exact F4 dispatch
actions: Bind released map, beam, mask, coordinates, temperature convention and processor to the existing Lorentz response.
Bind shared-sky cross-product covariance; retain actual ell0/1 removal and dipole reconstruction convention.
Convert consistent full-sky dipole and STF quadrupole joint draws to dimensionless d,S.
Dispatch full-sky alpha=4 moments to invariant kernel; keep old arbitrary-alpha/masked quadrature.
acceptance: Zero-boost, rotation and aligned/general-axis checks match existing response and exact moment oracle.
Mask/beam injection tests bind inference output to the released-product processing.
Directional Teff, angular-mean T0 and intensity-equivalent Tbol stay distinct.
Temperature S is not silently identified with dimensional kinematic shear.
Omitted-mode bound propagated through Jacobian or nonlinear posterior draws with stated norm.

Preserve global shared sky/object/calibration/velocity latent IDs across products.
Use real overlap and cross covariance metadata for existing CMB/DESI/CF4 products.

tasks.title: Physical response atlas and likelihood error budget
actions: Connect an actual physical native solver; existing synthetic native_reference remains a validation fixture.
Use fixed spans or local Taylor/interpolation cells and reuse compressed conditional quadratics.
Convert accepted physical remainder and numerical envelope to whitened mean-error delta.
Set cell size and evaluation precision from logL budget; propagate uniform proper-prior bounds to evidence only where supplied.
acceptance: Native solver agrees on independent held-out cases and known limits.
Certified envelope, empirical validation error and interpolation heuristic reported separately.
Cells violating the error budget refine or fall back to native evaluation.
Bayes-factor error sums both model evidence budgets; no local-to-global support overclaim.
Runtime/accuracy improvement measured against the same physical solver and observations.
